name: codewalk-agent
description: Task runner for the CodeWalk Agent monorepo (frontend: Next.js, backend: FastAPI).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/tools/typescript-analyzer ci && uv --directory backend sync
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: uv --directory backend run ruff check app tests && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format: uv --directory backend run ruff format app tests && uv --directory backend run ruff check --fix app tests && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.format:check: uv --directory backend run ruff format --check app tests && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: uv --directory backend run mypy && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:security: uv --directory backend run pytest -p no:cacheprovider -ra tests/test_agent_unit.py tests/test_paths.py tests/test_config.py tests/db/test_security_api.py tests/db/test_secret_paths_api.py tests/db/test_ownership_api.py tests/db/test_auth_api.py tests/db/test_agent_api.py tests/db/test_fixture_projects_api.py tests/db/test_concurrency_api.py
